label: Extended Senegalese feminist testimonial critique into structural bodily politics
description: Sharing Senegal’s Francophone feminist horizon with Mariama Bâ, Thiam combined anthropological interviews with militant feminist philosophy in La Parole aux Négresses.
dialecticalTension: Moves from epistolary critique of polygamy to radical bodily sovereignty.

label: Pioneered African women’s bodily autonomy discourse inherited by Tamale
description: Thiam’s insistence that African women themselves speak and theorize bodily integrity paved the way for Tamale’s Afro-feminist sexualities and legal scholarship.
dialecticalTension: Links Francophone West African bodily critique to East African decolonial law.
